name: sealed-session-publisher
goal: Prove sealed run revisions, unique live counters and encrypted transcript objects at the Mac publisher boundary

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: PR #310 sealed v1 wire contract. Assert opaque session id, increasing revisions, ordered binary frame counters, encrypted R2-sized transcript segment and native header-only authentication.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added the scoped native publisher, authenticated transport, and registered units. Mac activation is tracked separately as a dependency on enrolled scope keys and attachment to the run owner.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 3 publisher tests and 8 Hub Workerd route tests passed, including publisher-to-Durable Object binary output, D1 revisions, R2 transcript decryption and plaintext canary checks.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Prove captured transcript and live output agree through a synthetic enrolled account
steps.evidence: 17 focused tests pass. Synthetic Workerd account stores a signed genesis and wrapped grant, opens it for the Mac publisher, and verifies R2 bytes match the live stream counter. Simulated object and socket failures verify durable-before-live ordering and monotonic counters.
